notes: Observe when the World Cup Soccer ROM energizes the Loop Gate (public solenoid 34). Direct switch writes only, so PinMAME keyboard handling and the built-in simulator stay off. The coin-door switch and the five normalized trough optos are presented closed, credits are added through coin switch 1, the fresh-NVRAM notice is cleared through Begin Test and three Escapes, and a game is started; once the trough eject (public solenoid 6) proves a game is running, the served ball is reported leaving the trough, resting on the shooter switch and leaving it. As a control, the left-spiral switches (Travel Lane Rollover 47, then the spinner 27) are made with the Travel lamp (63) unlit. Then both top rollovers (Upper Left Lane 87, Upper Right Lane 88) are made, which lights Travel, and the spinner is made; then both top rollovers again and the travel lane rollover. Each input changes alone with a settle interval. This proves which public inputs the ROM answers with solenoid 34 and for how long, not the gate's physical position or which way it moves.
